status: Native roll completion revalidates recipients, safely resolves stale loot and preserves inventory-full retry; automated checks pass; client verification pending
scope: Code/data checks only. Separate completion fix after the focused vote-admission commit; no SQL, live item flags, rates/counts or character changes.
problem: CountTheRoll trusted admission/votes from earlier in the roll and called StoreNewItem directly. A voter could reach10/10 or lose the personal landing/item quest before resolution and still receive a conditional/quest item.

A missing winner prevented another eligible voter from winning and could leave the item permanently blocked. EndRoll did not remove an invalid registry entry because its null getLoot no longer matched the original Loot pointer.

Completion directly indexed ordinary/quest vectors and did not reject already consumed or replaced slots. The ordinary-slot path remained defective after the separate quest-vote fix: at02840772 the executable probe logged RECIPIENT quota vote=1 timeout=0 target=0->1 master=0->0 blocked=1.
implementation: Resolve the native slot once through GetItemInSlot; end an invalid roll without granting if its slot is absent, already looted, currency, empty or has a different ItemID from the roll. Reuse the validated item throughout delivery rather than indexing vectors repeatedly.

Before winner selection, rebuild NEED/GREED/PASS tallies using native current recipient admission: real lookup/contact, current or original party membership and full Loot::AllowedForPlayer including actual CurrencyID/type/quest flag/item condition pointer.

Treat an ineligible vote as PASS. Preserve the original participant in native completion broadcasts so a still-online client can receive the existing close/result flow; it cannot win. Valid NEED priority and original-party membership remain supported; an eligible GREED voter can win when the only NEED voter is now ineligible.

Unblock the validated item as the roll ends, including no eligible winner, absent winner and full inventory. Capacity remains a native delivery check, not a reason to select another winner; existing retry behavior is retained.

EndRoll now cleans invalid registry entries as well as rolls matching its Loot. Existing native winner delivery, bonuses, achievements and disenchant branch remain; this work does not certify disenchant delivery.

coverage: Both human/orc recipients; actual GroupLoot participant creation, CMSG_LOOT_ROLL wire decode, WorldSession handler, CountRollVote/CountTheRoll, native packets and StoreNewItem inventory delivery. A valid NEED or GREED voter becomes10/10 before the last vote or corpse timeout. With an eligible GREED alternative, stale NEED loses and that alternative receives one item; without an alternative no item is granted and loot is unblocked. Baseline gives the expired voter one item instead.

Missing personal landing, missing fragment item quest, both recipients ineligible, missing ObjectAccessor player and detached current party. Original-party-only membership retains valid NEED priority. A missing winner with no fallback cannot leave loot blocked.

Already-looted and mismatched-ID slots cannot grant again. Cleared LootMgr registration cannot retain an active roll. Current-only missing-slot EndRoll safely cleans up; the baseline deliberately skips that unsafe direct-index case and the quest-only missing-item-quest case that its earlier vote bug prevents from reaching completion.

Current quota example: target0->0, master0->1, blocked0. NEED/GREED full-inventory failure preserves the item/unlootedCount and actual StoreLootItem delivers after a real backpack slot is freed. Repeated EndRoll never grants a second item.
